name: Adele Flamel
source:
A member of the mafia group 'Evening Star'.
His true form is of the demon of lust Asmodeus. So he excels with techniques to corrupt women.
A confident person who is always hyper-positive when it comes to love.
He has a lazy side so he gets along well with [url=/c43596]Belial[/url].
